headline: Ahn'Qiraj in 1:08 with no wipes, and the Bug Trio cloud as the one bad moment

mvp.headline: the most damage on the Bug Trio and the Twins, top six on every boss
why: First on the Bug Trio (124k) and the Twin Emperors (153k), second on Fankriss, Ouro and C'Thun

also.text: parse 99 on Huhuran, the Twins and C'Thun, and one of the two Frenzy Tranquilizing Shots
the most healing on six bosses, 89k on C'Thun
61 dispels, three times the next healer

overview: Nine kills on nine pulls in 1:07:58, ten minutes under a usual night. C'Thun went down in 3:55 without a single death, and Viscidus, Huhuran, the Twins and Ouro were all faster than usual.
The Bug Trio cost six deaths, four of them in Lord Kri's Toxic Vapors around 0:30, and with them world buffs: 33 had Rallying Cry on the Trio, 26 on Sartura. Skeram was fought with buffs stored.
Trash took 13 deaths, six of them to Impales and falls among the Vekniss Guardians.

wentWell.text: C'Thun in 3:55 (median 5:11) with no deaths, Eye Beam hits at half the usual rate and a parse median of 83 against a usual 62.
Huhuran in 0:42, both Frenzies tranquilized (Slappin and Speldosan), 16 Nature Protection Potions.
8 of Skeram's 10 Arcane Explosions kicked (Fluffycatto and Lebh 2 each).
Twin Emperors in 3:10 against a usual 4:03, Blizzard hits at a third of the usual rate.

notes.text: 1:04 (median 1:13), no deaths, 8 of 10 Arcane Explosions interrupted. Alanakos top at 640/s.

1:36 (median 1:21), 6 deaths. Labwar, Shaaw and Stinkycat died to Toxic Vapors at 0:29 to 0:30, Harrylarry to Toxic Volley at 0:32 and Alanakos to Ravage at 0:34, then Künigünde to Toxic Vapors at 1:01. Toxic Vapors hits ran at twice the usual rate, so most likely Kri died where the melee stood.
Yauj started 5 Great Heals and 3 were kicked; the other two healed her for 152k, where a usual kill has none.
1:13 (median 1:10). Whirlwind killed Harrylarry at 0:40 and Stinkycat at 0:50, at about the usual hit rate. Akinf top at 1406/s.
1:43 (median 1:59), no deaths, Poison Bolt Volley at two thirds of the usual rate. Taurenlover healed 68k.
3:10. Amima died to Vek'nilash's melee at 1:42, the only death. Heal Brother healed the emperors for 120k, where a usual kill has none, so they were close together at least twice.
1:26 (median 1:43). Stinkycat died to Sand Blast at 0:49, the only death. Osinir top at 1743/s.
3:55, no deaths. Seven raiders went to the stomach, about a third of the usual rate. Eïnherjar top at 168k.
